# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository's existing guidance, including `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Issue-first code changes

- Before making a code change, identify a relevant GitHub issue in this repository. If none exists, create one describing the requested outcome, intended approach, and acceptance criteria before editing code.
- Record meaningful changes in intent on the issue, and reference the issue in the work and any pull request.
- Follow applicable permissions. If Issues or access prevent finding or creating an issue, stop and ask instead of changing code.
- This requirement applies to code changes, not questions or research.
